cost_budget.request_cap_basis: Veasel is limited to 84 attempts at 8192 input / 2048 output tokens. OpenCode is limited to 29 upstream attempts, 32768 serialized UTF-8 request bytes per POST, and 2048 output tokens per request. The resulting USD 0.10690560 is an estimate only; serialized bytes do not prove provider-billed input tokens because Responses framing/tokenization has not been bounded.
cost_budget.estimated_cost_note: Assumes request-body bytes equal uncached input tokens and every request uses the full output cap; this assumption is not a provider-verified billing bound.
